documentMetadata.title: 170.315(b)(10) Electronic Health Information (EHI) Export
documentMetadata.versionDiscrepancy: Cover page says 'Version: 1.0' but footer on all subsequent pages says 'v2.0 | April 25, 2024'

exportMechanics.vendorAssistedFees: Fees may apply based on time and effort

entities.description: Demographics and clinical records in C-CDA R2.1 format. Always produces a pair of XML and HTML files. No TYPE value in filename. Vendor provides no field-level documentation; defers entirely to the HL7 C-CDA R2.1 specification.
entities.notes: C-CDA R2.1 can contain sections for demographics, problems, medications, allergies, immunizations, vital signs, lab results, procedures, encounters, care plans, goals, social history, and more. The vendor does not specify which sections are populated or what coded values are used.

entities.description: Billing and claims data at the line-item level, including CPT, ICD, NDC codes, charges, multi-payor payments, adjustments, write-offs, and balances.

fields.description: Patient IDs. These are unique
The date of service being billed
The insurance payor the for the data of service
The rendering provider who performed the service
The CPT code billed
The ICD code being associated with the CPT code that is billed
The NDC code for drugs billed that have been administered or rendered
The modifier code associated with the CPT code billed
The amount billed
Payment received from the primary insurance plan/payor
Payment received from the secondary insurance plan/payor
Payment received from the tertiary insurance plan/payor
Payment received from other sources
Payment received from the patient
Patient outstanding balances
Balances that have been adjusted or written off
The patient account balances including pending claims

entities.notes: Column numbering in the PDF has an error: both 'Payor' and 'Provider' are listed as column 3, making subsequent numbers off by one. There are 17 distinct column names (rows) in the table, numbered 1-16 in the PDF with one duplicate.

entities.description: Telephone calls and adhoc notes documented via the Patient Notes feature. Includes authoring user, subject, category, date, and full note text.

fields.description: Patient IDs. These are unique
Patient note IDs. These are unique
The user who documented the note
The subject of the note. This field maybe blank
The category associated with the note. These categories are user defined but available from a pick list for the user
The date the note was created
Documented details of the patient note

entities.notes: Column numbering in the PDF has an error: both 'User Name' and 'Subject' are listed as column 3. Actual sequential column numbers are 1-7. Categories are user-defined pick lists.

entities.description: All patient scanned and uploaded documents, encoded using Base64 within CDA XML. May be large depending on volume of scanned data.
entities.notes: Contains scanned/uploaded documents as Base64-encoded attachments within a CDA wrapper. No field-level documentation provided.

parseNotes.columnNumberingErrors: Both CSV tables in the PDF have column numbering errors where column 3 is listed twice. The actual columns are sequential; the vendor has a copy-paste error in the numbering.
parseNotes.ccdaCoverage: The vendor provides zero field-level documentation for C-CDA content. We cannot determine which C-CDA sections are populated or what data elements are included without sample export files.
